title: The Sneaky Snail
level_description: Vowel teams (ee, ea, ai, oa): snail, see, sea, trail, boat, 12-18 words per page

character.name: Snail
character.description: Cute small yellow snail with spiral brown shell, two eyestalks with friendly eyes, leaving sparkly trail

pages.image_prompt: NO TEXT IN IMAGE. Cute yellow snail with spiral shell peeking around leaf, mischievous friendly expression, eyestalks up. Garden background. BOLD BLACK OUTLINES. Children's book style.

pages.text: Snail was slow. Snail did not need to be fast.
pages.image_prompt: NO TEXT IN IMAGE. Cute yellow snail moving slowly along garden path, peaceful content expression, leaving sparkly trail. BOLD BLACK OUTLINES. Children's book illustration.

pages.text: "I want to see the sea!" said Snail.
pages.image_prompt: NO TEXT IN IMAGE. Yellow snail looking toward distant blue sea on horizon, dreamy hopeful expression, eyestalks pointing forward. BOLD BLACK OUTLINES. Children's book style.

pages.text: Snail went on the road. The trail was long.
pages.image_prompt: NO TEXT IN IMAGE. Snail starting journey on winding road, long path ahead, determined expression. Sparkly trail behind. BOLD BLACK OUTLINES. Children's book illustration.

pages.text: A bee said, "You are too slow!"
pages.image_prompt: NO TEXT IN IMAGE. Striped bee zooming past slow snail, bee looking impatient. Snail not bothered, calm expression. BOLD BLACK OUTLINES. Children's book style.

pages.text: But Snail could see a leaf the bee did not see!
pages.image_prompt: NO TEXT IN IMAGE. Snail noticing beautiful detailed leaf that busy bee missed, snail stopping to look closely. BOLD BLACK OUTLINES. Children's book illustration.

pages.text: A toad said, "You need to leap and run!"
pages.image_prompt: NO TEXT IN IMAGE. Toad jumping past snail, toad looking smug. Snail watching calmly, not rushing. BOLD BLACK OUTLINES. Children's book style.

pages.text: But Snail could see a trail of seeds to eat!
pages.image_prompt: NO TEXT IN IMAGE. Snail finding delicious seeds on ground that rushing toad missed, happily eating one. BOLD BLACK OUTLINES. Children's book illustration.

pages.text: Rain came! The bee and toad ran to hide.
pages.image_prompt: NO TEXT IN IMAGE. Rain falling, bee and toad rushing frantically to find shelter. Snail not worried. BOLD BLACK OUTLINES. Children's book style.

pages.text: But Snail could wait. Snail had a shell!
pages.image_prompt: NO TEXT IN IMAGE. Snail tucked happily inside shell while rain falls, cozy and dry, peeking out peacefully. BOLD BLACK OUTLINES. Children's book illustration.

pages.text: Snail went on. Snail went up a tree!
pages.image_prompt: NO TEXT IN IMAGE. Snail slowly climbing up tree trunk, still calm and happy, enjoying the climb. BOLD BLACK OUTLINES. Children's book style.

pages.text: Snail could see so much from up in the tree!
pages.image_prompt: NO TEXT IN IMAGE. Snail at top of tree, looking out at beautiful view - flowers, road, and sea in distance. Wonder on face. BOLD BLACK OUTLINES. Children's book illustration.

pages.text: At last, Snail got to the sea!
pages.image_prompt: NO TEXT IN IMAGE. Snail arriving at beach, blue sea waves in front, joyful expression, eyestalks raised high. BOLD BLACK OUTLINES. Children's book style.

pages.text: Snail saw a boat, a seal, and the deep blue sea!
pages.image_prompt: NO TEXT IN IMAGE. Snail on beach looking at boat on water, seal playing, beautiful blue sea. Taking it all in slowly. BOLD BLACK OUTLINES. Children's book illustration.

pages.text: "I am slow. But I see it all!"
pages.image_prompt: NO TEXT IN IMAGE. Happy snail sitting peacefully on beach rock, watching sunset over sea. Content, satisfied expression. BOLD BLACK OUTLINES. Children's book style.
NO TEXT IN IMAGE. Snail leaving sparkly trail on beach as sun sets over sea. Peaceful ending. BOLD BLACK OUTLINES. Children's book illustration.
